text:
ellie: FYI inbound handoffs spiking for APAC this morning. noticed many leads landing in 'unassigned' for ~90s. HubSpot->SF sync shows TTL hits and RR assigning to owners who haven't been active.
paul: ugh. any logs or sample?
ellie: pasted one event (sanitized): 
```json
{"hs_id":"cn_778","created":"2026-03-23T03:20:10Z","enrichment":"failed","assign_attempts":[{"owner":"u_32","last_seen_ms":720000},{"owner":"u_77","last_seen_ms":102000}],"hs_sf_delay_s":78}
```
noor: looks like enrichment timeout + round-robin chosen a stale owner. our fallback to overflow pool didn't trigger. I think the RR selector isn't checking last_seen properly when enrichment_status != "ok".
chris: quick mitigation proposal: 1) bump enrichment TTL from 8s -> 14s (canary) 2) add a staleness gate in RR `owner_last_seen_ms > 300000 -> skip` behind FF `rr_staleness_gate` 3) ensure fallback_to_overflow boolean is true when enrichment fails.
ellie: can we do a small canary on APAC marketing lane only? need business signoff for flipping owners in that lane.
paul: yes canary ok. ops-bot: Triggered: deploy canary hs-enrichment-ttl-bump by noor at 1769958210. dashboard: https://deploys.redwood/1769958210
noor: deploying RR gate as FF now. i'll also add metrics: `handoff_success_rate`, `hs_sf_sync_latency`, `rr_skipped_stale_count`.
james: add a page rule: `hs_sf_sync_latency > 60s for 5m` -> page on-call weekdays 24x7? maybe just 9-6 local. suggest page 9-5 PT for now.
ellie: agreed 9-5 PT. paul: action items: (a) canary TTL bump (noor) (b) enable fallback boolean when enrichment fails (noor) (c) rr_staleness_gate FF rollout (noor) (d) alert + pager (james) (e) update inbound-handoff playbook with rollback steps (paul). i'll draft playbook and include rollback snippets.
chris: small note: add a nonblocking metric to the marketing dashboard to show percent of owners with last_seen > 5m so PMs can watch.
noor: canary metrics: after 30m handoff_success_rate improved from 82% -> 96% in canary lane. rr_skipped_stale_count = 24. pushing to EMEA next.
ellie: thanks team. posting playbook snippet here when ready. :rocket:
